About Windrose Guides

A community-built guide hub dedicated to helping players master Windrose — faster.

Our Mission

WindroseGuides.com exists because we were new players once too — confused about wind mechanics, unsure which ship to build first, getting destroyed in PvP zones. We built this site so the next generation of Windrose players can skip the frustration and get straight to the fun.

What We Cover

  • Beginner Guides – From your first spawn to your first proper ship
  • Ship Builds – Every ship class, compared and explained
  • Survival Tips – Staying alive in storms, monster encounters, and PvP zones
  • Multiplayer – Crew up, assign roles, and dominate together
  • Settings & FPS – Performance guides for every PC tier
  • Resources & Crafting – Farming routes and recipe databases

Disclaimer

WindroseGuides.com is a fan-made site and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to the developers or publishers of Windrose. All game content, names, and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Guide accuracy is maintained by community contributors. If you find outdated information, please reach out.
